build_r2d2_learner: build an R2D2Learner with networks, optimizer, replay iterator, and hyperparameters for recurrent DQN training
run_sgd_step: run a pmap-parallelized SGD step on replay samples to update online and target network parameters
compute_loss: compute the transformed N-step Q-learning loss with importance sampling weights and priority scores
update_priorities: update replay buffer priorities asynchronously using a mixture of max and mean TD errors
save_restore_state: save the TrainingState to disk or restore a checkpoint to resume R2D2 training
